description: This file contains implementation of platform-specific functions for the DRM PlayReady library, including initialization, deinitialization, and a decryption proxy function that handles secure pointers and converts them to buffer manager handles.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_init()
methods.description: Initializes the DRM platform library, logs a warning message, and returns success.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_deinit()
methods.description: Deinitializes the DRM platform library, logs a warning message, and returns success.

methods.description: Proxies a DRM decrypt call, converts a secure pointer to a handle if decryption is successful, and manages error handling.
